paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.4, which represents a 3.03% decrease from the prior close and a 2.4% increase over a window of 23 sessions. The price is as of August 14, 2026.

Recent news headlines include reports of the company's CEO Toby Neugebauer leaving the company and an Interim Office of the CEO being set up, as well as speculation about a potential connection to OpenAI. Other news includes the company receiving a US subpoena tied to Project Matador and submitting its Q2 2026 SEC 10-Q report.

There have been recent SEC filings, including a 10-Q report and several 8-K reports, which include the appointment of a new CEO, Lee McIntire, and the disclosure of financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. There has also been one Form 4 filing, but no Form 144 filings.
